_doc: Indicator registry for the Swedish edition. One entry per indicator; app.js reads this and never hard-codes a number. Every code here was read out of data/raw/scb_*.meta.json — scripts/validate_indicators.py re-checks all of them against that metadata and fails on a code the source does not have. `level` = the finest geography the indicator natively exists at; `levels` = every level it is built for. `sources[].geo` names the level of that one pull and `sources[].pull` names the raw file it comes from (data/raw/<pull>.jsonl.gz). `sources[].vintage` records which SCB region re-cut the codes belong to — RegSO2025/DeSO2025 for the 2025-01-01 division, RegSO2020/DeSO2018 for the older one. Never join across vintages. `sources[].vars` is the exact selection inside that pull; `share.of` lists the codes of the same dimension that form the denominator, `share.of_contents` a denominator that is a different ContentsCode. `moe` is present only where the source publishes a margin of error, and names the ContentsCode that carries it — render the ±, and suppress values whose margin is wider than `suppress_if_rel_gt` of the value. Suppressed source values (`..`/null) stay null and render as '–'; they are never imputed and never 0. `hue` is the RGB target of the choropleth ramp. Attribution: Källa: SCB, licence CC0.
vintage_note: SCB re-cut RegSO and DeSO on 2025-01-01. Tables carrying both vintages are pulled on the 2025 codes (suffixed _RegSO2025 / _DeSO2025), which is what the downloaded geometry uses. TAB5750, TAB5956 and TAB6258 exist only on the older codes and are therefore not used by any indicator below.

indicators.label: Population growth
indicators.desc: Population change over the last 12 months, % of the population a year earlier.
indicators.source: SCB TAB6574 (population by region, age and sex, 31 Dec) · TAB6473 (monthly, kommun)
indicators.direction_note: population growth is not good or bad in itself — a shrinking kommun and an overheating one are different problems, not a ranking

indicators.label: Share aged 20–34
indicators.desc: Persons aged 20–34 as % of the total population (ages 20–24 + 25–29 + 30–34 ÷ total).
indicators.direction_note: age structure is a descriptor

indicators.label: One-person households
indicators.desc: Single persons without children (ESUB) as % of all households.
indicators.warn: ESUB is 'single without children'. ESMB — single WITH children — is not a one-person household and is deliberately excluded.
indicators.direction_note: household structure is a descriptor

indicators.label: Foreign background
indicators.desc: Persons with foreign background (born abroad, or born in Sweden to two foreign-born parents) as % of the population.
indicators.direction_note: a population descriptor, not a score

indicators.label: Net income, mean per person
indicators.desc: Mean net income per person, SEK thousands per year, constant prices (income component 240 = net income).
indicators.warn: Published with a ~13-month lag; latest year is 2024. Constant prices — not comparable with nominal series.
indicators.direction_note: mean net income per person

indicators.label: Median disposable income
indicators.desc: Median equivalised disposable income, SEK thousands per year.
indicators.source: SCB TAB6684 (equivalised disposable income by region)
indicators.note: TAB5750 also carries a RegSO median, but in price base amounts, RegSO only, frozen at 2023 and on the RegSO2020 vintage — TAB6684 is preferred because it is current, on the 2025 vintage and exists at all three levels.
indicators.direction_note: median disposable income

indicators.label: Persons with capital income
indicators.desc: Share of persons with any capital income, % — a wealth proxy, since Sweden publishes no small-area wealth statistic.
indicators.source: SCB TAB6683 (income component 230, share with income)
indicators.warn: Presence of capital income, not its size. A krona of bank interest counts the same as a large capital gain.

indicators.label: Low economic standard
indicators.desc: At-risk-of-poverty rate: share of persons in households below 60 % of the national median equivalised disposable income.
indicators.note: Stands in for the Danish housing-benefit indicator. Försäkringskassan publishes no verified kommun breakdown of bostadsbidrag, so this is the affordability proxy.
indicators.direction_note: at-risk-of-poverty rate — SCB publishes it as a deprivation measure

indicators.label: Unemployment rate
indicators.desc: Unemployed as % of the labour force, ages 20–64. Kommun figure is the monthly register series; RegSO/DeSO is the annual register.
indicators.source: SCB TAB6260 (monthly, kommun, preliminary) · TAB6680 (annual register, RegSO/DeSO)
indicators.warn: Register-based (BAS), not the ILO-definition AKU survey — levels differ from the headline national unemployment rate. Kommun series is preliminary and revised.
indicators.direction_note: unemployment rate — adverse by definition

indicators.label: Employment rate
indicators.desc: Employed as % of the population aged 20–64.
indicators.source: SCB TAB6260 (monthly, kommun) · TAB6680 (annual register, RegSO/DeSO)
indicators.direction_note: employment rate 20–64 — higher is the sound end

indicators.label: Post-secondary education
indicators.desc: Population 25–65 with post-secondary education (levels 5 and 6) as % of those with a known level of education.
indicators.warn: Denominator excludes 'US' (level of education unknown) — including it would understate every area, and the unknown share is far larger in areas with recent immigration.
indicators.direction_note: an education descriptor; treating it as a score would rank people

indicators.label: Rent, median
indicators.desc: Median annual rent per square metre in rented dwellings, all owner categories, including heating and water.
indicators.warn: Sample survey of ~16 000 apartments. Every value carries a margin of error (000000J3) — render the ±, and grey kommuner whose margin exceeds 15 % of the value. Fully suppressed kommuner (e.g. Malå 2418) stay null and render as '–', never 0.
indicators.direction_note: a rent is a cost to one side and income to the other

indicators.label: Rent, mean
indicators.desc: Mean annual rent per square metre in rented dwellings, all owner categories.
indicators.warn: Same sample survey and the same suppression rules as the median. Reference: Stockholm (0180) 2025 = 1 734 ±19; median 1 710 ±28.
indicators.direction_note: as rent

indicators.label: Rent by owner category
indicators.desc: Median rent per m² split between allmännyttiga (municipal) and private landlords.
indicators.warn: PANEL ONLY, NEVER A MAP. This split exists for six aggregate region groups — Stockholm/Göteborg/Malmö and three size classes — not per kommun. Sweden publishes no private-vs-allmännytta rent split below that.
indicators.direction_note: as rent

indicators.label: New-build rent by rent-setting model
indicators.desc: Annual rent per m² in newly built rented dwellings, split by how the rent was set: negotiated bruksvärde, presumtionshyra (with or without an investment subsidy) or individually negotiated.
indicators.warn: PANEL ONLY. Six national groups, three years (2022–2024) — there is no kommun breakdown. Presumtionshyra exempts a new build from the bruksvärde cap for 15 years, which is why new-build rents sit far above the stock they are built next to.
indicators.direction_note: as rent

indicators.label: Vacant dwellings, multi-dwelling buildings
indicators.desc: Share of dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings standing vacant and available for rent on 1 March, by owner category.
indicators.warn: STALE AND PANEL ONLY. Triennial, six national groups, and the series stops at 2024 (2019, 2021, 2024) — SCB has announced no next publication, so this does not track the current market. It is a sample survey and carries a margin of error.
indicators.direction_note: vacancy cuts both ways — slack for a tenant, loss for an owner

indicators.label: CPI, actual rents paid
indicators.desc: Consumer price index, COICOP 04.1 'actual rental payments made for housing', monthly, 2020=100.
indicators.warn: CPI was rebased to 2020=100 in January 2026 — store the base year with the value. Sweden's leases index is CPI for October, not a net price index; the Danish NPI has no counterpart (the Swedish net price index died in 2013M12).
indicators.direction_note: an index level

indicators.label: Rented dwellings
indicators.desc: Hyresrätt (rented) dwellings as % of all dwellings.
indicators.warn: 'ÖVRIGT' (tenure unknown) stays in the denominator — dropping it would inflate every share. TAB6638 starts in 2024, so there is no sub-municipal history.
indicators.direction_note: tenure mix is a descriptor

indicators.label: Flerbostadshus share
indicators.desc: Dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings as % of the stock (kommun); persons living in multi-dwelling buildings as % of the population (RegSO/DeSO).
indicators.warn: The two levels measure different things — dwellings at kommun, persons below it. Label the sub-municipal value accordingly.
indicators.direction_note: building-type mix is a descriptor

indicators.label: Floor space per person
indicators.desc: Average useful floor space per person, m², all households and all types of housing.
indicators.note: Stands in for the Danish average dwelling size. TAB826 (dwellings by floor-space band, kommun) supports a band-weighted mean dwelling size if that is wanted instead; TAB5291 was checked and covers only three regions, so it cannot carry a map.
indicators.direction_note: floor space per person is a descriptor

indicators.label: K/T-tal, småhus
indicators.desc: Köpeskillingskoefficient: purchase price divided by assessed value for sold permanent småhus, unweighted annual mean.
indicators.warn: THIS IS NOT A PRICE PER SQUARE METRE and must never be labelled as one. Sweden publishes no open realised price per m² at any geography. K/T-tal also drifts with the assessment cycle: assessed values are re-set every three years, so the ratio jumps downward in a general assessment year regardless of what prices did.
indicators.direction_note: K/T-tal is a valuation ratio, not a score

indicators.label: Mean purchase price, småhus
indicators.desc: Mean purchase price of sold permanent småhus, SEK thousands, with the number of sales (BO0501C1) alongside it.
indicators.warn: Not size-adjusted — a kommun of large houses reads high for that reason alone. Kommuner with very few sales in a year are noisy; show the sales count with the price.

indicators.label: Småhus sales
indicators.desc: Number of sold permanent småhus in the year.

indicators.label: Bostadsrätt price, mean
indicators.desc: Mean purchase price of sold bostadsrätter, SEK thousands, by län.
indicators.warn: A LÄN FIGURE, NOT A KOMMUN ONE. Sweden publishes no bostadsrätt prices below county level, so every kommun in a län shows the same figure — 21 values on a 290-kommun map. It is also a price, not a price per m²: nothing adjusts for the size of what was sold.

indicators.label: Forced sales of homes
indicators.desc: Properties and bostadsrätter sold by Kronofogden at executive auction, per 10 000 dwellings, both property types together.
indicators.warn: A LÄN FIGURE, NOT A KOMMUN ONE. Kronofogden publishes no municipal breakdown, so every kommun in a län shows the same rate — the map has 21 values, not 290. Read it as a regional level, never as a difference between neighbouring kommuner. Nationally 753–920 homes a year recently, so a single län-year is a small count.
indicators.direction_note: executive auctions by Kronofogden — adverse by definition

indicators.label: Assessed value per unit
indicators.desc: Total assessed value divided by the number of assessed units (BO0601B3 ÷ BO0601S1), SEK thousands per unit — all typkod, hyreshus included.
indicators.note: Resolved from the old BO0601A path by scripts/discover_scb.py. Typkod 320–325 are the hyreshus classes; 220/221 are småhus, also available per-unit in TAB5149.
indicators.warn: A kommun total would just track how much property a kommun contains; per unit is the comparable figure. Assessed values are re-set on a three-year cycle, so the level steps in a general assessment year.

indicators.label: Assessed value per småhus
indicators.desc: Average total assessed value per småhus assessment unit (typkod 220), SEK thousands.

indicators.label: Dwellings completed, last 4Q
indicators.desc: Dwellings completed in newly constructed buildings over the last four quarters, per 1 000 existing dwellings.
indicators.warn: Not adjusted for reporting delays — the most recent quarters are revised upward.

indicators.label: Dwelling starts, last 4Q
indicators.desc: Dwellings started in newly constructed buildings over the last four quarters, per 1 000 existing dwellings — the leading half of the pipeline.
indicators.warn: Starts are revised more heavily than completions. TAB6925 carries the same measure with specialbostäder split out, from 2007 only.

indicators.label: Dwellings completed, last 4Q (count)
indicators.desc: Dwellings completed over the last four quarters, absolute count.

indicators.label: New dwellings that are hyresrätt
indicators.desc: Share of completed new dwellings built as hyresrätt, latest full year.
indicators.warn: Annual, and small kommuner complete nothing in many years — a null year is 'no completions', not 0 %.

indicators.label: Building permits, dwellings
indicators.desc: Dwellings granted a building permit for new construction, quarterly.
indicators.source: SCB TAB2534 (BO0701 Bygglov) · gross floor area in TAB796
indicators.warn: PANEL ONLY, NEVER A MAP AT KOMMUN. Verified 2026-09-20: this table's Region dimension holds 30 codes — riket, the three metro areas, four riksområden and the 21 län. There is no kommun level for building permits. DATA_MAP_SE.md §1b previously implied one; it does not exist.

indicators.label: Socio-economic index
indicators.desc: SCB's socio-economic index for the RegSO, with the area type classification (000008IU) alongside it.
indicators.warn: RegSO only — there is no DeSO or kommun value. A composite of education, economic standard and benefit dependence; read it as a classification, not a measurement.
indicators.direction_note: SCB's socio-economic index — which end is 'better' is not stated in the metadata on disk, so it stays neutral until it is verified

indicators.label: Housing-market balance
indicators.desc: Each kommun's own assessment of its housing market — shortage, balance or surplus — from Boverket's annual Bostadsmarknadsenkät, question "Hur bedömer ni för närvarande kommunens bostadsmarknadsläge? [I kommunen som helhet]".
indicators.warn: Self-reported by the kommuner, not measured — it is an opinion survey with one response per kommun, and what counts as 'balance' is explicitly left to each kommun to interpret. Three or four kommuner do not answer in any given year and stay blank. Attribution to Boverket is required by the licence.
indicators.note: 2020 and 2021 worded the answers differently ("Obalans - underskott på bostäder"); scripts/import_bme.py normalises them. The trend over 2020–2026 is real: shortage fell from 212 kommuner to 102 while surplus rose from 8 to 55.
indicators.direction_note: categorical — shortage/balance/surplus already carry their own colours

indicators.label: Mortgage rate, new agreements
indicators.desc: Lending rate to households for housing loans, by original rate fixation period, monthly.
indicators.note: Resolved from the old FM5001C path by scripts/discover_scb.py. TAB5780 carries the wider lending-rate series back to 1987M03. Avtal 0100/0200 distinguish new agreements from outstanding stock — check the label before charting.
indicators.direction_note: as policy_rate

indicators.label: GDP, volume change
indicators.desc: GDP at market prices, change in volume against the same quarter a year earlier, and the seasonally adjusted quarter-on-quarter change.
indicators.note: Resolved from the old NR0103B path by scripts/discover_scb.py.
indicators.direction_note: shown as a national card, not ranked

indicators.label: Property price index, småhus
indicators.desc: Fastighetsprisindex (FASTPI) for permanent småhus, Sweden, 1981 = 100, annual.
indicators.warn: Index, not a level — it says how prices moved, never what a house costs. Sweden publishes no open realised price per m² at any geography.
indicators.direction_note: an index level

indicators.label: Policy rate
indicators.desc: Riksbank policy rate (styrränta), daily.
indicators.warn: NOT YET ON DISK — the Riksbank fetcher is not written. Verified live 2026-09-14: 1.75 % as of 2026-08. STIBOR series closed in 2020 and must not be used.
indicators.direction_note: a macro rate has no better end

indicators.label: Government bond, 10 yr
indicators.desc: 10-year Swedish government bond yield, daily.
indicators.warn: NOT YET ON DISK. Verified live 2026-09-14: 3.15 % at 2026-09-09.
indicators.direction_note: as policy_rate

indicators.label: CPI
indicators.desc: Consumer price index, total, and KPIF (CPI with fixed interest rate), monthly.
indicators.warn: Rebased to 2020=100 in January 2026 — always store the base year with the value.
indicators.direction_note: an index level

indicators.label: Municipal tax rate
indicators.desc: The kommun's own income-tax rate for the year, excluding the regional and burial levies.
indicators.warn: Comparable across kommuner, but it is a rate, not a burden: what a household pays also depends on the regional rate, which this excludes. Gotland reads 33.6 % against a national median of 21.9 % because it is both a kommun and a region and levies both rates — that is the data being right, not an outlier to clean.
indicators.direction_note: a higher rate buys more service — not a ranking

indicators.label: Net operating cost per inhabitant
indicators.desc: Verksamhetens nettokostnader from the kommun's income statement, per inhabitant.
indicators.warn: Driven as much by what a kommun is obliged to provide — a scattered or ageing population costs more per head — as by how it is run.
indicators.note: Kolada carries this with the income statement's sign, i.e. negative because it is a cost; the sign is flipped here so the indicator reads as the cost it is.
indicators.direction_note: net operating cost per inhabitant is a descriptor

indicators.label: Long-term debt per inhabitant
indicators.desc: Långfristiga skulder of the kommun (not the group), per inhabitant.
indicators.warn: The kommun alone, not the kommunkoncern: a kommun that holds its housing company's borrowing in a subsidiary reads low here. Compare with the equity ratio before drawing conclusions.
indicators.direction_note: långfristiga skulder per inhabitant — lower is the sound end in municipal finance, and Kolada presents it that way

indicators.label: Equity ratio incl. pension liability
indicators.desc: Soliditet including the pension commitment — own capital as a share of total assets.
indicators.warn: Can be negative when the pension commitment exceeds own capital, which is normal for many kommuner and not by itself a distress signal.
indicators.direction_note: soliditet incl. pension commitment — higher is the sound end
